Scope: playgrounds at three locations (Qassim Oasis, Hail and Tabuk Industrial City), with civil, architectural, electrical, mechanical and landscape works and general site works, including air domes at Qassim and Tabuk and a toilet building at each site.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (weekly report, Physical Progress sheet). At 01-Nov-2026 the project is 80.06% complete against 85.46% planned, behind by 5.40% (SPI 0.94). It gained 2.42% this week against 2.20% planned, so the gap narrowed slightly.

The schedule now finishes the project 69 days after the contract date. The P6 update (data date 30-Oct-2026) and the weekly report both forecast handover on 23-Feb-2027 against the contract completion date of 16-Dec-2026, with −58.8 days of float; last week the forecast was 14-Feb-2027. 169 of the 301 open activities have negative float and 37 activities have failed to start. The air domes are furthest behind: Qassim 39.96% against 83.02% planned and Tabuk 35.13% against 78.32%, with no progress this week.

Data notes

  • Progress figures are the weekly report's physical progress (effort), weighted by 33,340 budgeted man-hours, of which 10,000 belong to the “Project milestone” management line. The report's dashboard and the Weekly Progress Report presentation show cost-based progress labelled as actual; this report uses physical progress only.
  • The report states “Current Contract Weeks: 0 of 0”, so the week number is counted from site handover (17-Feb-2026): 257 days, week 36.
  • The “Weekly Physical Progress” columns hold 77.20% planned and 70.12% earned, which match neither week's to-date figures. Progress this week is taken as the change in to-date progress since the 25-Oct-2026 report.
  • All major quantities are identical to the 18-Oct and 25-Oct-2026 reports, although tartan, irrigation and curbstone work was reported; the sheet appears not to have been updated.
  • Man-hours by site: Tabuk toilet building still shows 0 of 1,708 man-hours earned with only 40 planned, and Tabuk closeout has no budget but 71.68 man-hours earned.
  • The milestone sheet gives complete construction as 06-Feb-2026 with 0 days change, and complete mobilisation as 14-Apr-2026 against 18-Mar-2026 with 0 days change.
  • Procurement: the summary has 8 of 57 materials on site, unchanged for two weeks, while the P6 delivery activities are 70–95% complete. The procurement log has no delivered quantities or dates.
  • Invoices: the summary shows 0 submitted invoices while the log lists IPC-01 and IPC-02. Paid invoices (3,436,604 SAR) exceed the gross submitted value although none is PM-approved. The dashboard's penalties of −373,711 combine advance payment recovery and deductions.
  • Manpower: the dashboard shows 0 non-manual staff against 16 a week earlier, and the November columns of the Manpower sheet are empty. The DB sheet still holds another project's data (HAL1-02-005).
  • The P6 update has a data date of 30-Oct-2026, against 01-Nov-2026 for the weekly report; 131 in-progress activities have a finish date before the data date. Three PDFs are named MLTX-05-047 although they belong to MLTX-02-003.
  • The contractor forecast in the Physical-Chart Data sheet starts at 0 in February, 365 man-hours below the actual, so it stays slightly below actual until October.
